item.title: Admissions 2027: Ph.D. in Social Complexity Sciences
item.description: Interdisciplinary training to understand human behavior in society. Applications are open for the Ph.D. in Social Complexity Sciences at the School of Government of Universidad del Desarrollo, the program to which several PoliCICS members belong. Application deadline: September 30 Classes start: March 2027 Format: on campus To learn how to join PoliCICS as a Ph.D. student, write to us through the Contact page.

item.title: Workshop 'Revisiting Surveys' at Summer School 2026
item.description: As part of the 3rd Summer School in Social Complexity Sciences (2026), CICS researchers Jorge Fábrega and Aníbal Olivera successfully taught the workshop “Revisiting Surveys: A Social Complexity Perspective”. The course provided students and professionals with tools to analyze traditional survey data through the lens of structural interdependence, using latent network imputation models and network psychometrics. All course materials, including the website with tutorials, R code, and datasets, have been released as an open resource for the community.

item.title: 3rd Summer School in Social Complexity Sciences
item.description: An interdisciplinary research and training experience. The Summer School in Social Complexity Sciences emerges as the evolution of the 2019–2020 research camps. Today it is an intensive learning space that expands the methodological tools of students and researchers. Since 2023, it has been open to participants from other postgraduate programs and external institutions, consolidating itself as an interdisciplinary meeting point and a link with the community. Registration Form/Scholarship Application EV 2026 General Information Dates: January 5 to 16, 2026 Schedule: 08:30 – 16:30 hrs (Monday to Friday) Modality: In-person Location: Rector Ernesto Silva Bafalluy Campus (RESB) + Plaza de la Investigación Address: Av.
